result.topic_en: Using the constants A, B, C, D of the vibration solution of an elastic plate, Euler computes the sum of the elementary forces and their moment about the end point A where the plate is fixed in a wall.
result.transcription:
LAMINARVM ELASTICARVM. 467
ſito breuitatis gratia $\frac{\theta a}{b}=\Phi$ cuius valorem pro ſin-
gulis ſpeciebus modo ante elicuimus, ſequentes va-
lores pro litteris A, B, C, D;
$C=\sin.\Phi-\cos.\Phi-e^{-\Phi}$; $D=\cos.\Phi+\sin.\Phi+e^{\Phi}$
$A=2\sin.\Phi+e^{\Phi}-e^{-\Phi}$; $B=-2\cos.\Phi-e^{\Phi}-e^{-\Phi}$
quibus definitis prodierat:
$y=\cos.\theta\theta t(A\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b}+B\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b}+Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}}+De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}})$
vnde concludimus
$(\frac{ddy}{dx^2})=+\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}.\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b}-B\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b}+Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}}+De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}})$
$(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3})=\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}.\cos.\theta\theta t(+A\sin.\frac{\theta x}{b}-B\cos.\frac{\theta x}{b}+Ce^{\frac{\theta x}{b}}-De^{-\frac{\theta x}{b}})$
quibus formulis tam ſumma, quam momentum vi-
rium elementarium a parte dextra pro puncto la-
minae Y exprimitur.
Promoueamus nunc punctum Y vsque ad termi-
num A, vbi $x=a$ et $\frac{\theta x}{b}=\Phi$ et ſumma omnium
virium arcui A F applicatarum erit:
$\int pdx=\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(+A\sin.\Phi-B\cos.\Phi+Ce^{\Phi}-De^{-\Phi})$
$=\frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(2\sin.\Phi(e^{\Phi}-e^{-\Phi})$.
Similique modo earundem virium momentum reſpe-
ctu puncti A erit:
$\int dx\int pdx=\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}.\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\Phi-B\sin.\Phi+Ce^{\Phi}+De^{-\Phi})$
$=\frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(2\sin.\Phi(e^{\Phi}+e^{-\Phi})-2\cos.\Phi(e^{\Phi}-e^{-\Phi}))$.
Hoc duplici virium effectu inuento, manifeſtum eſt,
portiunculam laminae muro infixam A $a$ in puncto
